newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson starts Great Western consent drive.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson starts Great Western consent drive.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co Monday said it started a consent solicitation of Great Western Financial Corp shareholders to support its $6.2 billion bid for Great Western.

On Friday, the Delaware Chancery Court ruled that Ahmanson could proceed with its plan to solicit consents from Great Western shareholders. The ruling stemmed from a request by Great Western for a temporary restraining order against the consent solicitation. The court reserved its ability to rule on the merits of Great Western's request, pending the outcome of the consent solicitation.
Ahmanson said the Great Western board has not responded to the merger proposal it submitted two weeks ago.
It has, however, taken a series of actions that have delayed the ability of Great Western's stockholders to express their view on the proposal, Ahmanson said.
Great Western officials could not be reached for comment.
